shares_one_cause.instructions: Do the failures in `failures` share one cause that a single instruction to the agent could prevent?

criteria.true: The same mistake recurs across the failures, so one instruction (always do X, never do Y) would have prevented most of them.
criteria.false: The failures have different causes, or causes outside the agent's control such as timeouts, outages or missing access, so no one instruction would prevent them.
